question: Which products were picked for order 421, and what is the average number of units picked for each product, using FIFO (First-In, First-Out) method?
sql:
-- Let's also verify total units picked per product for order 421
SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, 
       SUM(pl.qty) AS total_units_picked,
       COUNT(*) AS num_picking_lines,
       AVG(pl.qty) AS avg_units_picked
FROM picking_line pl
JOIN products p ON pl.product_id = p.id
WHERE pl.order_id = 421
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY p.id
